notes.title: 5/27 (Tue) Update Notice
notes.notes:
[h3]Thank you for playing JR EAST Train Simulator.

It took about one year from conception to implementation!
Today, Tuesday, May 27, we implemented a randomization of signal indications on 16 of the existing distribution routes!
Signal Indications Change for the Same Driving!?
For more information on signal indications, please check out the following!
[list]
[h3][b]【Until now】[/b][/h3]
The timing of the signal change by the preceding train was controlled based on pre-created data.However, because the signal present is always fixed, the timing of the signal change is the same no matter how many times you drive, and once you learn it, it has become uninteresting.
This time, we have added randomness to these changes, making driving more realistic by changing the timing each time the player drives.

[h3][b]【This update】[/b][/h3]
Because the delay of the preceding train is now a random event,the signal indications will change every time the same train runs on the same timetable （Due to randomness, delays may not occur）。
This allows players to enjoy different operating conditions for each play, even on the same schedule.
Note that the same signal will not be displayed each time the train is operated in the delayed setting section, and it is not possible to redo the operation. Even if you select a station again from the pause menu during operation, a new signal opening time will be set.

[h3][b]【Points of Attention】[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]The target section is randomly determined in addition to the number of seconds of delay.Because even if the number of seconds of delay of the preceding train is shifted by a certain value, it can be easily exploited if the amount of shift is known.
[*]Although it may be delayed excepting of time check station,the train is set to arrive on time at the time check station.
[*]Sometimes the departure signal is a stop signal until just before departure time.
[*]It is more important than ever to drive according to the schedule. Since stop signals are also likely to occur, please be careful not to drive too fast. If the security system brakes due to stop signals, etc, there will be a significant delay and the train may not arrive on time.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896253/5200decf11d40b22b094cfeca0c91f656928f62f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896253/77c8fbe6baa96f15107cf00f1253b27e702481c7.jpg[/img]
Signal indications change even under the same timetable and operating conditions!

[h3][b]【Target Routes】[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Keihin-Tōhoku・Negishi Line
[*]Tōkaidō Line
[*]Chuō Line Rapid Service
[*]Saikyō Line・Kawagoe Line
[*]Senseki Kine
[*]Keiyō Line
[*]Yamanote Line
[*]Jōban Line
[*]Nambu Line
[*]Tsurumi Line
[*]Sōbu rapid Line
[*]Takasaki Line
[*]Utsunomiya Line
[*]Yokosuka Line
[*]Ōme Line
[*]Tōkaidō Freight Line
[/list]
[h3][b]【Major highlights of the route】[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Keihin-Tōhoku・Negishi Line：
From Minami-Urawa,The train will catch up with the preceding train , increasing the number of times it approaches the pattern. This will be a test of your skill in braking without compromising riding comfort.
[*]Chuō Line Rapid Service：
The 602H Commuter Special Rapid was originally jammed by the train ahead, but it has more frequent deceleration, caution, warning, and stop signals. More careful speed control is required by anticipating the train ahead.
[*]Senseki Line：
The train ahead may be delayed to a degree not seen in the normal schedule, and the ATACS feature may cause the train to stop near the train ahead.
[*]Saikyō Line・Kawagoe Line：
It is set up up to Ōmiya. It often catches up with the preceding train between Ōsaki and Ikebukuro.
[*]Keiyō Line：
The player must avoid hitting the pattern as he/she will receive a caution or stop signal before Tōkyō Station.
[*]Nambu Line・Tsurumi Line：
Because of the short interval between closing signals, the train is operated by watching and anticipating the signal ahead. Since the opening time of departure signals is not displayed at non-time check stations, player may have to wait a long time for the signal to open.
[*]Utsunomiya Line：
 The 3520M Rapid "RABBIT"  is preceded by the "CASSIOPEIA" Sleeping Limited Express between Kuroiso and Utsunomiya and the "HOKUTOSEI" Sleeping Limited Express between Utsunomiya and Koganei, and may approach these trains. （Both are now out of operation）
You can  driving between the discontinued Sleeping Limited Express.
[*]Yokosuka Line：
More often than not, you will be forced to stop before Musashi-Kosugi Station.
[*]Ōme Line：
The train is almost jammed with trains ahead of it and cannot go very fast.Please adjust your braking to arrive at the time check station on time.
[*]Tōkaidō Freight Line：
A change in signal indications can be seen from the Tsurumi to Musashi-Kosugi area.
[/list]

[b]【Comments from the Development Team】[/b]
How much can be returned to regular time in the event of a delay?In other words, while there is not enough time to spare, please try to operate and carry out successfully the same schedule repeatedly so that the train can return on time by the terminal station while meeting speed limits, etc., and taking ride comfort into consideration!
[/list]

This is an all-out update that the simulator production team has worked together to implement!
It is more challenging than ever, so please take this opportunity to purchase it!

[h3]And we also have an announcement today about [b]the Jōban Line DLC upgrade[/b], so please take a look at that as well![/h3]
[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2111630/view/536602812925083680

notes.title: 5/27 (Tue) Update Notice
notes.notes:
[h3]Thank you for playing JR EAST Train Simulator.

Thank you for your patience, Joban Line fans!
Today, Tuesday, May 27,we have made the following Jōban Line DLC upgrades!

More realism with the implementation of driver's voice and automatic broadcasting!
Cab graphics and motor sounds are more realistic!
Further high-speed operation with the much-requested Special Rapid & 15-car formation timetable!

The updates are designed to maximize the appeal of the Joban Line,such as.
Please check out the details below!

[b]【Jōban Line DLC Major Update Overview】[/b]
[list]
[h3][b]【Implementation of driver's voice】[/b][/h3]
Driver's voice was implemented on all schedules, including those added in this update.
（In charge of the voice：Katsuta Unification Center）

[h3][b]【Implementation of automatic broadcasting】[/b][/h3]
Automatic broadcasting was implemented on all schedules, including those added in this update.
Existing operating schedule：Implementation of mixed voice and automated broadcasts
Additional schedule for this time：Implemented mainly automated broadcasts, assisted by  voice
                                                   （In charge of the voice：Both Katsuta Unification Center）

[h3][b]【Brush up motor sound and graphics】[/b][/h3]
Brushed up the motor sound and cab graphics of the E531 series.
The driver's cab graphic is more realistic in the light,and  the motor sound also reproduces the difference in tone between the DC and AC sections.

■Before and after update comparison video（DC section）
[previewyoutube=zlAG2x7lb1E;full][/previewyoutube]
■Before and after update comparison video（AC section）
[previewyoutube=SHEjE_8SKC0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]【Review of vehicle performance】[/b][/h3]
Vehicle performance during acceleration and deceleration has been reviewed.

[h3][b]【Implementation of additional operation schedules】[/b][/h3]
The 15-car and special rapid train schedules have been implemented in response to many requests.

If you already own the Joban Line DLC, please take advantage of this opportunity to see how different it is from the previous versions, and if you are a new player, please take this opportunity to enjoy the Joban Line DLC!

notes.title: A free trial version of “JR EAST Train Simulator” is now available!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing “JR EAST Train Simulator”.
We are pleased to announce the release of a “free trial version” of JR EAST Train Simulator, which allows users to play free of charge between Tokyo and Shinagawa on the Tōkaidō Line. The simulator is compatible with NVIDIA's GeForce NOW cloud game service, it will be possible to play the simulator on a variety of devices. We have prepared a trial version for you to experience the operation and feel of the simulator before purchasing.If you are considering purchasing the basic pack or individual lines, or if you would like to check the operation and feel of the simulator on your terminal, please use this trial version!
The free trial version will be available on GeForce NOW on Friday, December 6 (Japan time)（scheduled）, so please be patient.

notes.title: Simulator Status Update #1
notes.notes:
[b]About Frequency Environments other than 60hz Monitor Refresh Rate[/b]
This simulator was developed based on the assumption that the monitor refresh rate is 60 hz. We have received many reports of playback under other settings than 60 hz (faster or slower acceleration than usual), so we have modified some programs to work under other rates as well. Although this modification has expanded the playable environment, the display position has been shifted due to the modification, and we are currently considering how to address this issue.

[b]About monitor resolution[/b]
The simulator was developed assuming a monitor resolution of 1920 x 1080, but we have received reports that the simulator can be played on high resolution monitors such as 4K, so we are currently considering whether or not to support this resolution.

[b]About the number of sound channels[/b]
Currently, the simulator is designed to operate with 2 sound channels. We are currently considering the possibility of supporting multiple channels.

[b]Freeze at Now Loading screen[/b]
We have confirmed that the "Now Loading" screen freezes when a station is selected on the simulator immediately after PC startup.

[b]The screen does not display properly after the simulator is started.[/b]
This problem may occur when the system requirements described in the store page are not met. In particular, this problem occurs when the graphics board requirements are not met.
